name: Group 2 to 3 upgrade
description: One-shot upgrade path that migrates a site's Group module data and config from 2.x to 3.x during database updates.
project_description:
This module would no longer be necessary. The update from version 2.x to 3.x would be resolved with issue [#3440222]. 
 The module should only be used to upgrade the group module from major version 2 to major version 3.

 Once executed, this module must be uninstalled and removed.

 This module tries to resolve what was reported in issue [#3362037]

 Instructions 
 https://git.drupalcode.org/project/group2to3/-/blob/3.0.x/README.md?ref…
